metadata.description: Small packs of tested agent skills, one pack per domain.

plugins.name: mstack-3d
plugins.description: 3D models and scenes, proven by numbers and pixels: glTF gate, three.js render check, rig motion check, Blender jobs, text-to-3D acceptance.

plugins.name: mstack-ai
plugins.description: Checks for building with AI models and agents: gate an evaluation run, probe an MCP server, triage an agent trace, lint tool definitions, score retrieval, measure spend, test for prompt injection, check an LLM grader.

plugins.name: mstack-apps
plugins.description: iPhone apps in SwiftUI and Mac apps in Tauri: prove a screen on the simulator, record a flow, check store readiness, accessibility, signing and notarisation, Tauri configuration, crash reports, app size and release notes.

plugins.name: mstack-core
plugins.description: The base pack: prove work is done, delete safely, keep decisions, hand off a session, find the right skill.

plugins.name: mstack-data
plugins.description: Working with data: profile, check, diff and clean datasets, run and review SQL read-only, trace report numbers, compare groups, and audit charts, spreadsheets and notebooks.

plugins.name: mstack-design
plugins.description: UI and UX checks: gate a rendered page, audit accessibility, check tokens, build and match screens, check interface words, keep work on brand.

plugins.name: mstack-dev
plugins.description: Software development with proof at each step: plan, build, prove a test, debug, review, parallel work, commit, land a branch, release, security check.

plugins.name: mstack-growth
plugins.description: Getting a product found and understood: site audit, structured data, launch pages, posts, claims, first screen, tracking, store listing, page comparison, mail domain records.

plugins.name: mstack-lean
plugins.description: Cut token use in Claude Code: measure what loads at the start, how big a session is, what a fan-out will cost, which MCP servers are idle, and where usage went.

plugins.name: mstack-media
plugins.description: Audio, video and image work with a measured result: word-timed transcripts, subtitles, platform exports, podcast clean-up, show notes, transcript-based cuts and image batches.

plugins.name: mstack-ops
plugins.description: Running software: check a deploy, a migration, a backup, a CI file, a bill and a log with scripts that end in a stated result, and touch nothing live without a yes.

plugins.name: mstack-product
plugins.description: Requirement gathering and brainstorming: settle what is wanted, write a checkable spec, trace it to tests and code, put numbers on quality words, produce and compare options, test a plan's assumptions, and turn interview notes into evidence.

plugins.name: mstack-test
plugins.description: Software testing: QA a running app, pin down flaky tests, derive test cases, find untested risks, keep test data free of personal data, check an API against its contract, confirm a bug before reporting it.

plugins.name: mstack-web
plugins.description: Working with the live web, honestly: check a deployed site, find broken links, extract a page, check quotes against saved sources, plan a polite fetch, keep research sourced, measure transfer speed, watch a page for changes.

plugins.name: mstack-writing
plugins.description: Text work with a proof: copy-edits where every change is listed and nothing else moved, and translations where numbers, names, links and placeholders are counted on both sides.

plugins.name: mstack-xr
plugins.description: VR and AR without guessing: WebXR checks in an emulator, a numeric comfort audit, platform detection, and phone AR previews at real size.
